sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Public list of UI pieces
sections.what: Lists each public UI component and its helper types, including the seismograph chart, by pointing to the file each comes from.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives other code one import point.
sections.watch_out: The seismograph file is outside this packet, so its existence is not checked here.

summary: The front door of the UI folder. It lists the public components so other parts of the app can import them from one place.
purpose: Keeps imports short and gives one clear list of what the UI offers.
why: Likely reason: a common way to gather exports in one file. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Re-exports each component and its helper types from its own file, including the seismograph chart from the charts folder.
outputs: Named exports used elsewhere in the app.
risks: A component missing from this list must be imported from its file directly. A renamed file breaks this list at build time.
debug: If an import is not found, check this list and the file path it names.
